globalNews.title: Nepal rescuers blast hillside in search of hydropower workers as families wait anxiously
globalNews.summary: Rescuers have resorted to explosives as they struggle to reach trapped workers, as the flooding death toll reaches 939.

globalNews.title: US and Iran trade strikes for first time in weeks
globalNews.summary: The attack on Larak Island in the Strait of Hormuz - the first known US strike since late July - has killed two people and injured two others.

globalNews.title: Man arrested after Swiss rave shooting that killed woman
globalNews.summary: A 22-year-old Italian woman was killed and several injured at a techno rave in Aarau.

globalNews.title: The jury's options in Lindsay Clancy's murder trial
globalNews.summary: Jurors have five options before them as they decide the fate of the former nurse charged with killing her three children.

globalNews.title: 'She slipped out of my hand' - children missing after ferry sinks off northern Cyprus
globalNews.summary: Ayten and Hayri Bicer's two young children are among 20 missing in an incident that killed eight people.

cryptoNews.title: Webull expands crypto trading into Canada through Coinbase collaboration
cryptoNews.summary: The brokerage is adding digital assets alongside stocks, ETFs and options as Canadian crypto ownership rises and regulators move toward clearer industry rules.

cryptoNews.title: Bitcoin begins volatile monthly close as US bond yields eye new 20-year high
cryptoNews.summary: Bitcoin price action saw sharp moves within its local range as US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent addressed US bond yields.

cryptoNews.title: Bitmine now controls 4.9% of Ethereum supply after adding 53.5K ETH
cryptoNews.summary: Bitmine has bought Ether for 65 consecutive weeks, maintaining its accumulation strategy through a prolonged crypto downturn and $5.1 billion in paper losses.

cryptoNews.title: Strive buys 1,800 Bitcoin for $143M, becomes fifth-biggest corporate holder
cryptoNews.summary: Strive’s latest Bitcoin purchase lifted its holdings to 23,156 BTC, making it the fifth-largest publicly traded corporate holder as crypto markets rebound.

cryptoNews.title: Russian crypto trading to bring $46B to regulated exchanges in first year after legalization: Report
cryptoNews.summary: Regulated cryptocurrency exchanges may see more than $46 billion in crypto trading volume during the first year after legalization, according to estimates from the country’s largest bank.

aiNews.title: Instagram puts new limits on undisclosed AI profiles
aiNews.summary: As frustration over AI influencers has been growing, Instagram is limiting the reach of undisclosed AI profiles.

aiNews.title: Harvard Law dropout raises $6M for Blue Voice to build a ‘Harvey for police officers’
aiNews.summary: The seed round for the app that provides real-time legal and policy guidance to officers was led by  SignalFire and Las Olas VC.

aiNews.title: Clipto uses AI to search terabytes of video and is now valued at $250M
aiNews.summary: The three-year-old startup says it reached $15 million in ARR and profitability before raising its latest $15 million round.

aiNews.title: Nvidia’s $3.5B MediaTek bet reveals its plan for tackling Big Tech’s AI chip buildout
aiNews.summary: Nvidia invests $3.5 billion into Taiwanese chipmaker MediaTek. The deal shows how Nvidia plans to stay essential to AI infrastructure as Big Tech begins to build its own AI chips.

aiNews.title: Meeting note-taker Circleback adds a free tier to attract more customers
aiNews.summary: Circleback is also introducing new pricing plans starting from $14 per month.
